name: lark-agent-x-ts
description: 飞书 / Lark 网页版消息通道（迁移自 cv-cat/LarkAgentX）

scripts.build: bun build ./src/cli/main.ts --compile --minify --define BUILD_COMMIT=\"$(git rev-parse HEAD)\" --outfile dist/lark
scripts.proto:build: bun scripts/proto-pipeline/extract.ts && bun scripts/proto-pipeline/gen-protos.ts && bun scripts/proto-pipeline/gen-cmd-table.ts && bun scripts/proto-pipeline/build-assets.ts
scripts.build:all: for t in bun-darwin-arm64 bun-darwin-x64-baseline bun-linux-arm64 bun-linux-x64-baseline bun-windows-x64-baseline; do bun build ./src/cli/main.ts --compile --minify --define BUILD_COMMIT=\"$(git rev-parse HEAD)\" --target=$t --outfile dist/lark-$t || exit 1; done
